alex: Heads-up — release window kicks off in ~2h. Need final version bump PR merged + annotated tag and draft GH release published after artifacts land.
release-bot: CI artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/rdw-v1.8.0/build-2026-03-17.zip (auto)
alex: Quick checklist: 1) merge version-bump PR 2) confirm checksums & signatures 3) create annotated tag 4) upload signed artifacts to release assets 5) create draft release with changelog snippet
maria: on it — merged #4123, running final smoke now :white_check_mark:
jamal: checksum command I used: `sha256sum build-2026-03-17.zip > build-2026-03-17.zip.sha256`
nina: QA: found a tiny changelog nit — need a migration note for kv-cache behavior
alex: nina can you paste suggested one-liner?
nina: "Fix: ensure kv-cache invalidation during hot reloads (migration from 1.7.x)"
maria: checksum file uploaded to s3 and I signed locally: `gpg --armor --detach-sign build-2026-03-17.zip` — uploaded `.sha256` + `.asc` to s3
kevin: I can handle the annotated tag + draft release. Ping me when artifacts + checksums are in s3 and CI is green
alex: Copy of the tag/release steps to follow: 
```
# create annotated tag
git tag -a v1.8.0 -m "v1.8.0 — fixes and infra tweaks"
git push origin v1.8.0
# create draft release with gh CLI (attach assets and notes)
gh release create v1.8.0 ./build-2026-03-17.zip --title "v1.8.0" --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES.md --draft
```
Include `.asc` and `.sha256` as additional assets.
kevin: Plan: wait ~10m for final CI, then I'll tag + create draft and post the link here
release-bot: build passed — artifacts available: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/rdw-v1.8.0/bundle.zip
maria: Uploaded `.sha256` and `.asc` to s3://redwood-ci/releases/v1.8.0/ (public-read for GH attach)
kevin: tagged & pushed — draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.0 — attached artifacts and added changelog snippet. please review before publish :eyes:
alex: Quick review ping to QA/devops: nina, jamal, maria — thumbs?
nina: LGTM
jamal: LGTM
maria: LGTM
alex: I'll publish in 15m unless any objections
kevin: publishing now
kevin: published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.0 :tada:
release-bot: Release published by kevin (action: release/publish) — artifacts verified
alex: Nice work — adding a rollback note to post-release checklist. thanks everyone :rocket:
